The '''Abrion Major system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abrion Major/Legends|Abrion Major]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Abrion Major system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
